capabilities: detect the indentation level of a code block
remove leading whitespace from each copied line
preserve relative indentation within the code
support spaces, tabs, and fences longer than 3 backticks
extras: The README notes a quirk: indented code blocks only render as code blocks directly under a list item (bullet, checkbox, or number). Installable manually, via BRAT, or built from source.
motivation: The author wanted to fold code blocks inside lists and "couldn't find any other plugins that simply excluded the code block's indentation from the copying functionality".
problem: Obsidian's built-in code block copy includes the block's indentation, which users then have to delete manually, e.g. before pasting into a terminal.
summary: Clipboard hook that strips the leading indentation when copying fenced code blocks nested inside lists, so pasted code starts at column zero.
